aspect: Contradictory official instruction as a stressor
description: When the state, the attacker and foreign broadcasters each issue different advice on whether to stay or leave, the civilian is placed in a position where no compliance is possible.
energy_note: Obedience is not an option on offer.

description: Hours per day spent cross-checking claims across channels in two or three languages, performed by people who also have to eat and sleep.
energy_note: A second job as your own intelligence analyst.

description: Chronic exposure to coordinated deception produces durable cynicism. It protects against propaganda and also against public health advice, legal rights information and anything else that arrives through an institution.
energy_note: Armoured against the truth as well.

aspect: SECONDARY - it isolates you from people who were not there
description: Explaining to a colleague why you do not believe a government press release makes you sound paranoid. So you stop explaining, which is the isolation.
energy_note: Sane, and unable to sound it.
